query: My TechCorp A15G tablet screen flashes and then goes completely blank whenever I tap to open an email in Gmail, and after it works for a short time it goes blank again.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Email Server Connection Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Email server connection

actions.description: It will let you adjust Wi-Fi

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on Connections.
Tap on Wi-Fi.

actionableDeeplink.description: Turn Wi-Fi on or off in Connections

actions.actionName: Clear the Email App's Cache and Data
actions.description: It will clear the email app's cache

steps: Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on Apps.
Select your email app.
Tap Storage.
Tap Clear cache.
Navigate to and open Settings.
Tap on Apps.
Select your email app.
Tap Storage.
Tap Clear data.
Tap OK.

actions.actionName: Check Email Access on a PC

steps: Try accessing your email on a personal computer.

actions.description: It will verify your phone's internet connection

steps: Ensure your phone is connected to a stable Wi-Fi or mobile data network.
Swipe down from the top of your phone's screen to open the Quick settings panel.
Touch and hold the Wi-Fi icon to check your connection status.

actions.description: It will try loading a webpage

steps: To confirm your internet connection is working, try loading a webpage or performing a quick search.

actions.description: It will review your email account settings

steps: Remove and re-add your email account to your phone to apply the new configuration.
Before proceeding, make sure you have your email account's username and password readily available.

actions.description: It will check your account server

steps: If you have followed all the above steps and are still experiencing difficulties with your email connection, contact your email service provider directly for further assistance.

actions.actionName: Restart Your Phone in Safe Mode
actions.description: It will check for problem apps

steps: Press and hold the Power button or Side button.
If your phone doesn't have a dedicated Power button, swipe down from the top of the screen to open Quick settings.
Tap the Power icon.
Touch and hold the Power off icon.
Tap Safe mode when it appears on the screen.
While in Safe mode, check if your email app is still experiencing issues.
Uninstall the email app if necessary while in Safe mode.
To exit Safe mode, restart your phone normally.
